items.title: 54270_Doc Cheatham oral history interview
items.q: That's where I first met Johnny Hodges... Oh yes. I've played with Johnny Hodges, yes.

ctx.x: Yes, but before Sam Wooding, I did work with Chick Webb's band. That's where I first met Johnny Hodges, and Freddy Jenkins. Well he was playing, like, dances.
